questions.question: Is the snapshot and CDC boundary precise?
questions.finding: The boundary is typed as snapshot frontier S plus contiguous interval (S,F]; transport acquisition remains unproven.

questions.question: Is ordering stronger than timestamp ordering?
questions.finding: Typed source position and transaction/event sequence govern order; timestamps are not ordering authority.

questions.question: Are transaction and checkpoint ambiguities acknowledged?
questions.finding: Checkpoint advancement requires durable target receipt; ambiguous acknowledgement is a recovery state, not assumed success.

questions.question: Is consumer-visible consistency stated honestly?
questions.finding: The active-generation pointer supplies one consumer view; cross-table storage atomicity is not claimed.

questions.question: Are deletes and schema changes first-class?
questions.finding: Delete lineage and schema quarantine have explicit contracts, invariants and adversarial cases.

questions.question: Can every material public claim be traced to evidence?
questions.finding: Ten registered claims have bounded labels and named proof references; new walkthrough surfaces must reuse registry wording.

questions.question: Are failure oracles stronger than workflow success?
questions.finding: Sixteen invariants have executable predicates and positive/minimal-negative cases; twenty-six adversarial cases expect exact diagnostics.

questions.question: Are local and AWS proof boundaries distinct?
questions.finding: Current proof is DESIGN_ONLY, LOCAL_VERIFIED or UNCLAIMED; no Stage 5 AWS or measurement promotion is permitted.

questions.question: Is complexity justified by the failure model?
questions.finding: Generation, checkpoint, proof and publication are separate because they fail independently; the readiness graph avoids new orchestration abstractions.

questions.question: Can a 2-YOE engineer plausibly own and explain the plan?
questions.finding: Repository navigation is prepared; owner ability remains a mandatory final-project human gate and is not inferred from documentation.

questions.question: Does the repository remain unmistakably ChangeBridge?
questions.finding: Stage 5 scope and scans are ChangeBridge-only.
